Rotation margin is 0.89, absorption is low (0.31), and one_narrative is false — so this is a dispersed, trend-gated regime, not a single dominant narrative. theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar (0.79) among all 49 names, eligible, trend tag, and breadth 0.889 — the most coherent trend-health profile in the book. Although crowding_z is high (1.68), guardrails say crowding only downsizes and never fades; the trend gate is the one validated drawdown-control leg and it is on. This is a stay-with-it lean on durability + trend health, not a momentum chase.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.68 is the most crowded scorable theme in the top decile; if crowded positioning unwinds, even a durable trend can gap. Pharma also has idiosyncratic policy/headline risk not captured by breadth.

falsifier.text: PPH loses its eligibility (trend gate off) OR lags SPY by more than 5% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar among eligible Healthcare (0.78) but much weaker score and breadth (0.667) than Big Pharma, so it's the lower-conviction cousin. The lean rests entirely on trend-health/durability staying power — not momentum — and its crowding is moderate (z=0.88), which is less of a caution than the pharma complex.
theses.dissent: Uses XLV as proxy, the same ETF as Health Care EW which is crowded (z=1.44); the theme is not cleanly separable in market instruments, and its score (0.095) shows little current flow.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its own 50-day trend regime (durability_bar drops below ~0.6) before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Top of the momentum ranks (score 2.305) but the trend gate is OFF (eligible = false), breadth is 0.0, and durability_bar is only 0.3. The one validated edge is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate, and this theme has lost it. Rotation shows it as leader with a 0.89 margin, but rotation timing has no forward edge and the leader itself is gate-ineligible — a textbook case for not chasing the headline rank.
theses.dissent: A sharp HBM/memory upcycle can re-enable the trend gate quickly (the theme may be early in a genuine cyclical turn), and rank 1 attention can persist longer than fundamentals justify.

falsifier.text: SMH re-enables eligibility (trend gate flips on) and breadth recovers above 0.5 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
